htmlBody:
Something new just shipped on the board. Today’s care is one Goldilocks move: not too much information, not too little meaning — pick the note that fits today’s noticing.

If you want a map for that: Stability isn’t sitting still. Also new on the board: Just right is a living balance. A hospitality note on the board, if you need it: More engines, empty workshops: when linear AI horsepower stops buying progress.

What to do with it today: listen when the field gets loud, claim a little personal space, make something true, prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.

highlights.title: Stability isn’t sitting still
highlights.blurb: A spinning top stays up because it moves. Families, crews, and AI tools stay workable the same way — parts and whole keep adjusting. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

highlights.title: Just right is a living balance
highlights.blurb: Goldilocks and Net Zero are the same filing when zero means active balance — not a frozen freeze. Viable middle for paychecks, doors, and SuperAI. Fair Exchange tip clause on.

highlights.title: Are we at the tipping point yet?
highlights.blurb: Yes — from ordinary life it looks like the triple tipping point is here: louder AI hype, thinner paychecks, tighter doors. Sodom and Noah as everyday rhymes, not prophecy. Fair Exchange tip clause on.
